update_description:
⚡ A Fresh New Experience

* 🫧 Colloidal Bounce Animation: Search button now delivers a fluid, colloidal jelly collision and bounce animation on scroll expand in Liquid Glass theme.
* 📜 Scroll Collapse Polish: Liquid bottom navigation bar smoothly collapses on scroll and springs back with tactile haptics, even when no music is playing.
* 🎤 Lyrics Auto-Hide Controls: Option to manually toggle or auto-hide player controls after 4 seconds of inactivity for a clean fullscreen lyrics experience.
* 🎵 Full Spotify Parity: Completely modernized Spotify integration aligned with the latest engine for reliable search, playlists, and recommendations.
* 🎬 Reels & Gestures: Ultra-smooth song switching, responsive mini player transitions, and refined visual aesthetics.
* ⚡ Engine Performance: Zero-delay instant playback pre-buffering, battery optimization, and stability fixes.
